name: Proximal Focus
body:
The mental contact of your magic allows you to send your stare across long distances.

Prerequisite(s): Hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus class feature

Benefit(s): When casting a mind-affecting spell, or detect/observe a creature through a divination spell on the same round you cast it, you may initiate your hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus as part of the same action on a failed saving throw(if any), regardless of range. If the spell is mind-affecting but does not allow a saving throw, you must be in the normal range of your focus or stare to affect them. If the creature moves out of the range of the spell, or the spell ends and the target is not within normal range of the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus, the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus ends. If there are multiple creatures affected or detected/observed by the spell, only one may be targeted by the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus. This feat does not obviate the requirements of a hypnotic focus or hypnotic stare other than its range. In particular, the Magnificence focus requires its target to be within the mesmerist’s aura.
